name: lambda:UpdateFunctionCode on arn:aws:lambda:*:*:function:svc-* (any svc-* function in ANY account) must warn
note: S1-dataexfil-arn iteration 4 BLOCKER regression: account-wildcard fail-open on a 'type:id'-form ARN in a non-IAM service. account='*' with concrete-prefixed identifier 'function:svc-*'. The resource identifier uses the colon form (function:name), and its first segment after the type is 'svc-*' (concrete leading char), so neither the type-prefix branch nor the head check fired; the old account-wildcard branch required an empty/leading-wildcard resource id. A wildcard ACCOUNT spans every account in the partition - update-any-svc-*-function's-code in every account. lambda:UpdateFunctionCode is non-read, so WILDCARD-RESOURCE (high) must fire.
